# PlotDetect — NSW Property Intelligence Platform
> Source: https://plotdetect.com.au
> Description: Structured planning compliance data, zoning analysis, and property feasibility tools for New South Wales, Australia.

## What PlotDetect Does
PlotDetect provides structured, machine-readable NSW planning data including zoning controls (FSR, height, lot size), development permissibility, DCP provisions, SEPP requirements, overlay constraints, and satellite property intelligence (flood risk, bushfire, shadow, solar yield).

## Primary Topics
- NSW zoning rules and permissible land uses
- Granny flat (secondary dwelling) eligibility and CDC compliance
- Development Application (DA) analytics and approval data
- Planning controls: FSR, height limits, lot size, setbacks
- DCP (Development Control Plan) provisions by council
- SEPP (State Environmental Planning Policy) requirements
- Overlay constraints: heritage, flood, bushfire, biodiversity, coastal
- Subdivision feasibility
- Climate risk assessment (flood, bushfire, coastal)
- Satellite property intelligence (shadow analysis, solar yield, development monitoring)

## Coverage
- All 128 NSW Local Government Areas (councils)
- 47,000+ regulatory provisions extracted from LEPs, DCPs, and SEPPs
- 27 spatial overlay layers (zoning, heritage, height, FSR, lot size, flood, bushfire, biodiversity, coastal)
- Development application data across NSW

## Key Content Hubs

### Planning Controls (per council)
https://plotdetect.com.au/planning-controls/{council-slug}
Structured LEP and DCP provisions for each NSW council. Councils with deep DCP extraction show topic-grouped provision counts (heritage, parking, setbacks, height, landscaping, etc.) with sample provision text.

### Granny Flat Eligibility (per council)
https://plotdetect.com.au/granny-flat/{council-slug}
CDC eligibility, lot size thresholds, setback rules, and approval statistics.

### Flood Risk Assessment (per council)
https://plotdetect.com.au/flood-risk/{council-slug}
Flood overlay data, planning constraints, and risk screening.

### Bushfire Assessment (per council)
https://plotdetect.com.au/bushfire/{council-slug}
BAL assessment, bushfire-prone land mapping, and planning implications.

### Solar Potential Analysis (per council)
https://plotdetect.com.au/solar-potential/{council-slug}
Shadow analysis, solar yield estimates, and roof assessment.

### Shadow Analysis (per council)
https://plotdetect.com.au/shadow/{council-slug}
Overshadowing assessment and solar access compliance.

### Development Monitoring (per council)
https://plotdetect.com.au/threat-radar/{council-slug}
Nearby development activity and change detection.

### Pre-DA Site History (per council)
https://plotdetect.com.au/pre-da-history/{council-slug}
Historical development applications and site activity.

### Conveyancing Reports (per council)
https://plotdetect.com.au/conveyancing/{council-slug}
Planning certificates, overlay checks, and due diligence data.

### Planning Glossary
https://plotdetect.com.au/glossary
465+ regulatory definitions from NSW LEPs, DCPs, and SEPPs. Includes FSR, GFA, CDC, setbacks, landscaped area, site coverage, secondary dwelling, and more — each with source document and clause citation.

### SEPP Housing Standards
https://plotdetect.com.au/planning-standards
Numeric development standards from SEPP (Housing) 2021 and the NSW Apartment Design Guide. Height limits, lot sizes, floor area, site coverage, parking, setbacks, and ADG design criteria — grouped by development type with clause references to NSW Legislation.

### Open Data
https://plotdetect.com.au/open-data
Catalogue of 5 structured NSW planning datasets available on PlotDetect: secondary dwelling statistics (102 councils), regulatory definitions (465+), heritage conservation areas (2,039), SEPP Housing numeric standards (56), and DCP provisions (10,008 actionable). Includes record counts, currency dates, source citations, and data caveats.

### Free Tools
https://plotdetect.com.au/tools/zoning-check — Check zoning for any NSW address
https://plotdetect.com.au/tools/subdivision-check — Subdivision feasibility checker
https://plotdetect.com.au/check — Quick compliance check

### Blog & Guides
https://plotdetect.com.au/blog — Planning guides, rules explainers, and property research
https://plotdetect.com.au/blog/granny-flat — Council-by-council granny flat guides (128 councils)
https://plotdetect.com.au/how-it-works — Platform overview
https://plotdetect.com.au/user-guide — Detailed user guide

## Data Sources
All planning data is sourced from authoritative NSW government systems:
- NSW Planning Portal API (zoning, overlays, LEP controls)
- NSW Legislation (EPIs, SEPPs, LEPs)
- Council Development Control Plans (extracted provisions)
- NSW Spatial Services (cadastral boundaries)
- Bureau of Meteorology (climate data)
- NSW Rural Fire Service (bushfire-prone land mapping)
